description.value: Matchstick is a Vancouver specialty coffee roaster with four community-focused café locations; this one sits in Davie Village, steps from Sunset Beach and English Bay. The Davie café features a full patio and accordion windows that open to the street, making it an airy place to linger after a seawall ride. All locations serve fresh-baked pastries and a full breakfast-and-lunch menu rooted in the brand's deliberately unhurried, craft-first ethos.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 55m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM coordinates (49.2829813, -123.1349451) place this node in Vancouver's West End near Davie St and Jervis St, matching the Davie Village location described on the website. The website confirms all four Matchstick cafés are active, serving fresh-baked pastries and a full breakfast-and-lunch menu; OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is not contradicted by the website, which emphasises 'wholesome foods.' No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, water-refill, or device-charging information appears in either the website content or relevant OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record carries no address; website content for the Davie Village location is truncated before the street number and phone number appear, so neither can be confirmed for this node.
Multiple Matchstick locations exist in Vancouver; check for duplicate OSM nodes covering the Fraser St, Riley Park, and Yaletown cafés.
